Kamyanka Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Cherkasy Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Classified as demolished, though its own preservation-condition category lists it as merely unfenced, and the physical description matches: most of the cemetery is in good condition, with missing tombstones on some graves rather than wholesale destruction — a mismatch flagged here rather than resolved. Sources disagree on its oldest tombstone: the ESJF survey found none earlier than the first half of the 20th century, while the Lo Tishkakh database cites one from 1905, a claim the ESJF team could not confirm. Notably, the cemetery includes at least one grave marked with a wooden cross and others from mixed marriages, alongside its Jewish burials.
